events.title: 1999 draws to a close and as the new millennium approaches, 리즈 유나이티드 are back on top though with just a one-point lead over 맨체스터 유나이티드 who have a game in hand. 아스널, 선덜랜드 and 리버풀 are the only three teams still posing a reasonable threat to the top two. 셰필드 웬즈데이's terrible season has continued as they remain bottom with a mere two wins and nine points from their first 20 games, while 왓퍼드 and 더비 카운티 remain in the bottom three. The race for promotion to the Premier League is still headed by 맨체스터 시티 and 허더즈필드 타운, while 찰턴 애슬레틱, 입스위치 타운, 반즐리 and 스톡포트 카운티 complete the top six.
